consumer_layout.name: block_q8_1_mmq
consumer_layout.contents: 128 int8 values and four F32 scales; transposed for contiguous shared-memory loads
consumer_layout.alignment: ne0 padded and required divisible by 4*QK8_1 (128)

current_lifetime.allocation: backend-private ggml_cuda_pool_alloc inside each ggml_cuda_mul_mat_q call
current_lifetime.consumer_api: currently asserts F32 src1 and performs its own quantization
current_lifetime.implication: a candidate needs a dedicated fused graph/backend path and a prequantized MMQ entrypoint; changing a graph tensor dtype or output pointer is insufficient

candidate_requirements.rmsnorm_to_shared_q81_gate_up: emit one exact D4 buffer after whole-row RMS reduction and learned scaling; retain it through both independent MMQs
candidate_requirements.swiglu_to_q81_ffn_down: combine elementwise SwiGLU with 128-value amax reductions and exact D4 packing, then pass the private buffer to one MMQ

aliasing.attn_post_norm: only gate/up MMQs consume this normalized value; residual uses the separately retained pre-norm tensor
aliasing.ffn_swiglu: only ffn_down consumes this value in the exact dense FFN graph
